effect: Triple Axel has Scatter 3. Triple Axel can’t target the same target more than once per use. On hit, push any lighter targets 10ft, if they collide with a wall, they lose 1d6 HP.

name: Triple Dive
effect: Triple Dive has Scatter 3. Triple Dive can’t target the same target more than once per use. On each hit, you may move up to 10ft.

name: Triple Kick
effect: Triple Kick has Scatter 3. On hit, any targets get Defense down.

name: Trop Kick
effect: On hit, the target gets Attack down. If they already have Attack down, they get Attack down down.

name: Twin Beam
effect: On hit, choose a second target in range to deal exactly half of the damage dealt to the first target to the second.

name: Twineedle
effect: On hit, choose a second target next to your first target to deal exactly half of the damage dealt to the first target to the second. On hit, 14 or higher during Accuracy Check inflicts Poisoned to both targets.

name: Twister
effect: On hit, if you haven’t used Twister yet this combat, inflict Dazed. Wind.

name: U-Turn
effect: On hit, switch places with an ally within 30ft.

name: Unbreakable Armor
effect: Stance: You take -12 damage from Physical moves. When you use an attack, if you don’t have any down you get Attack down down and SpAttack down down.

name: Unbreakable Barrier
effect: Stance: You take -12 damage from Special moves. When you use an attack, if you don’t have any down you get Attack down down and SpAttack down down.

name: Upper Hand
effect: Reaction [When you or an ally within range would be hit by a Priority attack.] Move to that ally, then that ally takes no damage and ignores any effects of the attack.

name: Uproar
effect: Uproar has Turns. [Turn 1, 2, and 3] You may move normally, then roll Uproar's Accuracy Check and power. Drowsy Pokémon within range of Uproar are cured of Drowsy and Pokémon cannot become Drowsy within Uproar’s range. Sound.

name: Vacuum Wave
effect: Vacuum Wave has Priority. Aura.

name: Venom Drench
effect: Venom Drench can only target a Poisoned or Toxified enemy. On hit, the target’s gets Attack down down, SpAttack down down, or Speed down down.

name: Venoshock
effect: If the target is Poisoned or Toxified, Venoshock has +2d8 power.

name: Vise Grip
effect: On hit, the target is Bound to you until the start of your next turn.

name: Victory Dance
effect: Choose and get two of the following: Attack up, SpAttack up, Defense up, or SpDefense up.

name: Vine Whip
effect: On hit, pull the target 10ft towards you if they are the same weight or lighter.

name: Vital Throw
effect: On hit, push the target 10ft away. If you miss, the target loses 1d6 HP and you may push them 10ft away.

name: Volt Switch
effect: On hit, switch places with an ally within 30ft.

name: Volt Tackle
effect: Volt Tackle has Priority if you use it on your first turn in combat. If you have max HP, Volt Tackle has +2d10 power. On use, you lose 3d8 HP.

name: Wake-Up Slap
effect: Wake-Up Slap never misses Drowsy targets, and removes the affliction on hit. Wake-Up Slap has +1d8 power for each affliction it removes. Wake-Up Slap deals no damage against allies.

name: Water Gun
effect: On hit, push the target 5ft. If they're adjacent to you, push them 15 ft instead.

name: Water Pulse
effect: On hit, 16 or higher during Accuracy Check inflicts Confused. Aura.

name: Water Shuriken
effect: Water Shuriken has Priority and has Scatter 5.

name: Water Sport
effect: You create a circle of Wet Terrain with a 60ft diameter.

name: Water Spout
effect: You create a circle of Raining Weather with a 60ft diameter. If you are at full HP, Water Spout has +2d8 power.

name: Waterfall
effect: On hit, 18 or higher during Accuracy Check inflicts Dazed.

name: Wave Crash
effect: If you have max HP, Wave Crash has +2d10 power. After use, you lose 3d8 HP.

name: Weather Ball
effect: If you are in Weather, Weather Ball changes its type to match the Weather and its range becomes (25ft, 10ft blast).

name: Whirlpool
effect: The area of Whirlpool becomes Whirlpool Hazard. Others in the Whirlpool Hazard take 5 damage at the end of their turns. They must make a Speed check of 15 to exit the Hazard or they can’t leave the Hazard.

name: Whirlwind
effect: On hit, moves the target 60ft away. Wind.

name: Wild Charge
effect: On hit, you lose 1d HP.

name: Will-O-Wisp
effect: On hit, the target is Burned.

name: Wing Attack
effect: On hit, move 10ft.

name: Wish
effect: Choose an ally within line of sight. At the end of the next round, they heal 25 HP.

name: Withdraw
effect: When hit by an attack, you may gain Defense up, but also gain Speed down.

name: Wonder Room
effect: You create a circle of Wonderful Zone with a 60ft diameter.

name: Wood Hammer
effect: You may spend 2d8 HP to make Wood Hammer Melee(10ft burst) as you use it. Wood Hammer can’t be used if you moved this turn.

name: Work Up
effect: If you have less than 20 HP remaining, you may add +1d to the power of an attack.

name: Wrap
effect: On hit, the target is Bound to you until you choose to release them during your turn. While Bound, they are Dazed if they try to move away from you and fail their check.

name: X-Scissor
effect: X-Scissor is Lethal.

name: Yawn
effect: On hit, inflicts Drowsy at the end of the target’s next turn.

name: Zap Cannon
effect: When you use Zap Cannon, you miss if you have moved this turn or target an enemy within 25ft. On hit, inflict Paralyzed.

name: Zen Headbutt
effect: On hit, 18 or higher during Accuracy Check inflicts Dazed.

name: Zing Zap
effect: On hit, 18 or higher during Accuracy Check inflicts Dazed.

name: Zone Blast
effect: If you are in a Zone, Zone Blast changes its type to match the Zone and its range becomes (25ft, 10ft blast).
